design_philosophy.mood: Sophisticated, Sterile but Warm, Premium, Clarity
core_principles: No Gimmicks (Remove ECG animations, remove mesh blobs)
Softened Clinical (Warm Grays instead of cold blues)

DashboardContainer.instructions: Remove the 'clinic-mesh' divs and SVG noise. Use a clean, solid background.

Header.instructions: Remove the purple linear-gradient. Use black text for high contrast. Remove the ECG SVG animation completely.

SOSButton.instructions: Make it distinct but not alarming. Use a soft red background with deep red text.

NoraAI_Card.instructions: Replace the video background with this subtle gradient. It feels more 'medical' and less 'marketing'.

implementation_steps: Locate the Web specific block (if Platform.OS === 'web')
Step 1: CLEANUP. Remove the <div className='clinic-mesh'> and the SVG noise div.
Step 2: HEADER. Change the header background from purple gradient to white/glass. Remove the ECG <svg>. Change text color to dark slate (#0F172A).
Step 3: CARDS. Update the 'style' props of cards to remove Neumorphic shadows (6px 6px...) and replace with 'Clean Clinical' shadows (0 10px 30px...). Increase padding to 24px.
Step 4: OBJECTIVES. Redesign the grid items. Remove the heavy borders. Use white cards with very subtle borders.
Step 5: NORA. Replace the video background in CopilotCard with a soft blue gradient.
Step 6: TYPOGRAPHY. Apply 'letterSpacing: -0.5px' to all headers (objectives, section titles) to make it look premium.
Step 7: SOS. Redesign the SOS button to be 'Soft Red' (bg-red-50) instead of white.
CRITICAL: Do not break the 'onClick' handlers or 'data-testid' attributes.
universal_guidelines: Use 24px border radius for all cards.
